newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India moves ahead as Taiwan recovers.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India moves ahead as Taiwan recovers.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts posted gains on Wednesday following strength in Bombay and after a lethargic showing earlier in the week.
Traders said the market had picked up in line with the local market but were uncertain about prospects for gains in the immediate future amid expectations of a consolidation in Bombay.
Hindalco continued to lead gains, adding $1.55 to $36.25/37.25 and ICICI was 31 cents firmer at $16.00/17.00.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 1.48 points firmer at 86.05, a 1.75 percent rise, with the premium over the local market at 21.27 percent from 19.46 percent.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index added 0.80 points to 96.22 -- a 19.91 percent premium to the local market. It measures from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 27.31 points to 4,244.89.
Taiwanese GDRs rebounded on a mild recovery in technology stocks in Taipei. They had fallen back on Tuesday despite a rise in the overall Taiwanese market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index climbed 1.09 points, or 0.78 percent, to 141.91, representing a discount to the local market of 0.75 percent.
Taiwan's weighted index added 50.45 points on the day to 9,942.79.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index shed 1.59 points to 73.54 points, a premium of 44.58 percent over the local market.
